With more than 20 teams and over 650 student-athletes, Life University is a great destination for aspiring student-athletes.

It's campus, just north of downtown Atlanta, is unique is that it is a 110-acre campus with beautiful trees, green spaces, and trails, but in an urban setting.

transcripts.transcript:
Life is unique in that it's a small school with a lot of diversity.

The cool thing about this school is like walking around and just hearing different accents everywhere.

It's not a very big school, but I feel like it's a very authentic school. Majority of the school is athletes.

I feel like everyone understands the struggles and that we're more than just rugby players or soccer players or vulnerable players, that there is other stuff besides that that we need to work with and like get around to make sure that we hit our goals.

You know, being a student in an in and of itself is a difficult thing.

Matching that with being an athlete is a whole nother ball game. Being in DC as well as an RA and a student athlete, that is actually a work in progress. But one thing has helped me from the start of the DC program and being an RA to now is time management.

It's easy to be a student athlete.

If you want to be good in class, you're gonna find time to study.

If you like what you're studying, of course you're gonna spend more time on that.

But it's not, it's not hard work playing both soccer and being in the DC program.

Is extremely hard to like, I'm not gonna lie, I'm late to school because of practice, or I'm late to practice because of school.

And I'm always like running between the two places, which is sad, but at the end of the day, like, I'm so, so grateful that I can do both these things.

Being a discomfort situation leads to an improvement of yourself.

Make you, make your yourself tougher, and helps you, helps you develop and gets better every day.

So for example, from making the bed as soon as you wake up to doing the little things but you gotta do, leads to bigger improvements in the future.

One of the greatest pleasures of being a collegiate athlete is that you get to be a part of a team environment.

You meet people from all around the world with different backgrounds, cultures, religions, perspectives on life, and that's something quite special.

So I think it's a privilege to be a student athlete, because not everybody can tell about themselves that they go to university study and also do their sport and also just, you know, making friends.

I think it's so much fun. I always try to finish everything as soon as possible.

So then I'm I'm free to enjoy my day with my friends or doing new experiences, I feel like, what makes it better as an athlete here is really the trainer, like, obviously for me, having, like, my meniscus torn and being through all the injuries and having to play on it, she's really keeping me going right now, just because I'm training with her consistently, where our coaches definitely set the standard from day one, whether it's from the recruitment process to practice the weights, you know, they make sure we're always on point and, you know, ready for anything.

Not a lot of people get to train every day.

Have all the resources.

Have a coach, have a PT, have people to push you.

I understand that it's an absolute privilege to wear the eagle on a Saturday, and it's something that many people don't get the opportunity to do.

I've learned so many lessons, but I think the most important you need to trust the process.

It has.

It's gonna have so many setbacks, but the way you react on things that's really important.

Time passes by really fast.

Opportunities come at you really fast, and if you let them go, they're gone.

So I just say that do as much as you can and enjoy it as much as you can.

Visit

Nestled in the heart of Pulaski, TN, the University of Tennessee Southern is dedicated to putting students first, catering to the diverse needs of our small-town community.

As a destination campus deeply committed to the student experience, we prioritize both academic excellence and the personal growth of every student.

UT Southern proudly stands as the fourth undergraduate campus in the UT System, serving as the sole public four-year institution of higher education between Chattanooga and Memphis.

Conveniently located along Tennessee’s southern border, our campus is situated approximately 70 miles south of Nashville and 40 miles north of Huntsville, Alabama.

Here's what makes us stand out: We offer 38 areas of study across six schools, providing tailored learning experiences with small classes and esteemed professors.

Our academic divisions focus on business, education, humanities, mathematics and sciences, nursing, and social sciences.

With a robust athletics department boasting 19 teams across 11 sports, UT Southern has something for everyone. We prioritize character development through 19 NAIA varsity sports, with an impressive record of 40 Mid-South Conference Championships and 12 National Championships.

Our commitment to success extends beyond the field, with 75 Athletic All-Americans and 215 Academic All-Americans recognized. Offering 11 Men's, 12 Women's, and 2 Coed Sports, we provide a comprehensive athletic experience.

UT Southern is dedicated to evolving our curriculum to reflect industry trends and technological advancements, emphasizing interdisciplinary studies for a well-rounded education.

We empower students to discover their passions, foster critical thinking skills, and graduate prepared for successful careers in an ever-changing world. At UT Southern, excellence is not just a goal—it's our commitment to every student who walks through our doors.

transcripts.transcript:
It begins, as all great things do, with a flicker, a spark of hope, a seed planted deep, waiting for warmth, a moment when you realize that, given the right conditions, everything is possible.

Welcome to the place of possible, the University of Tennessee southern is a family of leaders and scholars united by a single goal to grow the spark of greatness inside you into a future that transforms your family, your town and your world.

Here you'll spark your passion under the guidance of our nation's brightest minds who open a window to the world's wonders from close to home, you'll fan the fires of competition on the field, the court or the course honing skills you never knew you had to accomplish what you never thought you could.

You'll do it all while forging bonds that will last a lifetime and serving a community that values your talents, because here we think the best way to find yourself is to look beyond yourself.

There's a future waiting for you.

We'll help you build it.

Because what defines greatness as a single choice to not condemn the darkness, but to light a fire.

The University of Northwestern Ohio (UNOH) is a private, non-profit university in Lima, Ohio, founded in 1920.

The school has an enrollment of approximately 3,000 students on a 200-acre campus.

The university, accredited by the Ohio Department of Education and the Higher Learning Commission, offers master's degrees, bachelor degrees, associate degrees, and diplomas in more than 50 programs.

The school colors are burgundy, white, and black and the athletic teams, known as the Racers, compete in the National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) as members of the Wolverine–Hoosier Athletic Conference (WHAC).

UNOH supports 13 collegiate teams including Men's and Women's Basketball, Soccer, Tennis, Golf, Bowling, Men's Baseball, Women's Softball & Volleyball, and a co-ed Motorsports Racing Team.
